chapter: Duke, Gensel and the later years
title: The church band's personnel and the Zim album
summary: Norris Turney, Clifford Jordan and others; Gensel and McGhee pay for an album.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Norris Turney, Clifford Jordan, Russ Andrews...somebody else, I can't think of who it was, in the saxophone section. Anyway, mmm, who were the trumpet players...Eddie Preston, Nat Howard...I'm trying to think of the trumpet players... Oh boy. This ain't me today.
You also played at the Half Note with that band.
Yeah. We played down there. But I was trying to think of the personnel of the band... Anyway...

Well, the Reverend and I put together the date for that, and we paid for the date to record the band. But it came out on Zim Records. So he paid us about two thousand dollars to put it out -- which was all right. I mean, it was going to come out anyway, but it came out, and didn't raise no hell anyway. But it did sound good. Yeah, that one was really nice. I'll play it for you some time, if you haven't heard it.
Well, they play it on WBGO, and Phil Schaap plays it on his program too. But I guess you just haven't been lucky enough to hear it. Or maybe you have! Ha-ha!
